messages:
Maya R: quick question for API folks — should we offer a dry-run endpoint that resolves routing + throttles for SLO alerts so the console can preview who will be notified?
Ian L: yes. saves surprises during policy edits. include reason per target (pool_match | tenant_override | fallback).
Priya N: UX wants a compact 'why' column and a signal if that target is likely to be rate-limited currently.
Sam T: for privacy/cost, return full counters only in staging/dev. prod UI gets an obfuscated bucket (low/med/high). add a query param detail=full|summary.
Maya R: sketch of endpoint: GET /v1/slo/:id/notify-snapshot?dry_run=true&as_of=ts&detail=summary -> returns declared_policy + resolved_targets[] with reason & quota_status & expected_notify_fraction.
Ian L: sampling interacts badly — snapshot must say expected fraction and sampling_reason (cost_saving|regression_eval|audit).
Priya N: console should show a tiny timeline of last 6h notify volume for the pool and a 'will fallback?' flag if current quotas would trigger fallback.
Sam T: throttles: two layers: per-pool burst_quota and per-tenant steady_cap. on burst exceed, route to configured fallback chain. snapshot should expose fallback_chain preview.
Maya R: security: require scopes slo.read + notify.preview to get resolved_targets. otherwise only return declared_policy.
Ian L: make snapshot idempotent for a given as_of timestamp. also emit telemetry event notify.snapshot.request with outcome (previewed|blocked|partial) and sampling_reason.
Priya N: add UI test: tenant override pointing to deleted contact -> snapshot should include target_status: unreachable and suggested fix link.
deploy-bot: rollout planned: notify-snapshot-preview -> canary 3 hosts at 2026-03-10T09:00Z
Sam T: action items: Ian -> draft API spec + auth; Maya -> wire up API error cases; Priya -> mock preview UI + timeline; I'll draft default caps and fallback matrix. sync next Tue. :calendar:
